theorems.name: Submission.codim1_lurpt_rescaled_integral_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (J : Euclid n → ℝ) (K m : ℝ) (b : Euclid n) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), Continuous F → MeasurableSet B → Measurable J → (∀ a, 0 ≤ J a ∧ J a ≤ K) → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, m * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖F a - F b‖) → DifferentiableAt ℝ F b → Injective (fderiv ℝ F b) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ w in closedBall (0 : Euclid n) R, |B.indicator J (b + r • w) - J b|) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ c, B.indicator J (b + r • c) * f (r⁻¹ • (F (b + r • c) - F b)) ∂volume) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (J b * ∫ c, f (fderiv ℝ F b c) ∂volume))
